HOW ORDERING WORKS

A little clarity goes a long way.

What are decants?

Decants are smaller quantities transferred from an original fragrance bottle into a separate sample atomizer. The original manufacturer bottle is shown for identification only and is not included in the order.

Orders and delivery

This website is currently a pre-launch demonstration and does not accept purchases. Proposed minimum product order: AED 120. Proposed delivery: AED 15 below AED 200; complimentary from AED 200. Prices and shipping terms will be verified before activation.

Payments

Ziina integration is planned but is not enabled. A payment link will only be supplied after merchant eligibility, fragrance acceptance and relevant commercial approvals are confirmed.

Fragrance information

Fragrance notes are editorial descriptions. Sample images and specifications must be verified against the actual products before launching.
